generation: Built-in image_gen; five explicitly authorized four-piece family sheets; no API/CLI fallback
limitations: Returned source sheets are1254x1254 despite a2048 request. Native crops are not upscaled.
These are generated documentary-style concept references, not photographs of manufactured hardware or exact Blender renders.
Knurl counts, fasteners, dimensions and legend placement may differ from source geometry.
No per-pixel material segmentation or UV registration is claimed. Glass rendered alpha is coverage, not physical transmission.

Graphite_Alloy.usage: Retint/remap measured source microstructure; material is a finish approximation, not a measured aerospace alloy.

Titanium.usage: Retint/remap measured source microstructure; material is a finish approximation, not a measured aerospace alloy.

Sapphire_Glass.usage: Analytic dielectric; no opaque scan painted onto glass. Existing nav_screen procedural roughness is optional, not a factual scan.

Witness_Amber.usage: Analytic tinted lens/emission; not a measured material.
